decisions.reason: This core door lever family stayed listed through 2019 while sister lines A, D and E were dropped, which points to results meeting the aspiration, and a large firm in a growing industry has the slack to keep carrying it.
This single handle design survived the 2019 pruning of comparable designs and sits close to the established offer at low carrying cost, so there is no clear shortfall to prompt problemistic search.

The firm presents this electronic access system as a flagship of its digital building organization strategy and renamed it as a Pro version in 2019, so organisational commitment and slack favour keeping it even while its results are still uncertain.
